quarterly_data.quarter: Cloudflare press release: Cloudflare Launches Basin: A More Open and Accessible Data (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cloudflare Basin, a serverless data platform built on Apache Iceberg and Cloudflare R2 to ingest, store, catalog and query analytical data with no data-transfer fees, is generally available as of October 1, 2026. Named users: Anomaly (creators of OpenCode) moved its entire data pipeline to Basin, replacing an AWS S3 and Athena setup, and Bobsled builds data products on it.
